description:
Reassign orders between StarShipIt accounts using API keys. Use this to move orders from one StarShipIt sub-account or warehouse account to another.

**When to use:** Use in multi-account or multi-warehouse setups where orders need to be routed to a specific fulfilment account after initial import.

**Parameters:**
- `orders` (required) — Array of assignment instructions, each containing:
  - `order_id` (required) — The order ID to reassign
  - `current_api_key` (required) — API key of the account currently holding the order
  - `new_api_key` (required) — API key of the destination account

**Returns:** Confirmation of how many orders were reassigned.

**Errors:** 400 if any entry is malformed; 401 if any API key is invalid; 403 if you lack permission to access the source or destination account; 404 if any order not found.

current_api_key.description: API key of the account currently holding the order

new_api_key.description: API key of the destination account to reassign the order to

order_id.description: StarShipIt internal order ID to reassign

name: starshipit_assign_orders

outputSchema.description: Raw StarShipIt API response; not truncated

errors.description: Validation or processing errors returned by StarShipIt

object.description: The response payload when StarShipIt returns a non-object value

success.description: StarShipIt success flag (a boolean on most endpoints)

title: Assign Orders
